verdicts.rule: every measured frame has archive URL + SHA-256
centroid S/N >= threshold, at the predicted position, in >= 3 epochs
per-exposure offsets from >= 3 Gaia field stars in >= 3 exposures

constant flux rejected at p < 1e-3 within same-wavelength bins (errors incl. field-star floor); VARIABLE if max/min >= 1.2 and the rejection is seen in >= 2 bins with aperture photometry; otherwise POSSIBLE (low amplitude / one bin / saturated core)
verdicts.detail: chi2/dof = 41.9/8, p = 1.44e-06, max/min 4.74, floor 2.6%; signal only in PSF-wing fluxes of a saturated core

verdicts.rule: position residual vs brightness or wavelength, Pearson p < 1e-3 (4 tests, Bonferroni)
verdicts.detail: strongest: RA* vs wavelength, r = +0.58, p = 6.9e-07

verdicts.rule: 5-parameter fit (offset, proper motion, parallax) with no catalogue input; reliable only if the target is unsaturated (<50% of epochs with a flagged core), shows no photocentre shift, and the field stars' fitted parallaxes agree with Gaia (<=10% beyond 3 sigma, z spread < 2); detected if >= 3 sigma
verdicts.detail: parallax 591 ± 102 mas (Gaia 1.3, z = +5.8); saturated core in 100% of epochs; photocentre shifts with brightness or wavelength

verdicts.rule: Gaia field stars through the same pipeline: <=10% with |z|>3 and z spread < 2

caveats: The target is ~626x brighter than the calibration stars; the photometric floor measured on them may not capture bright-star systematics (non-linearity, saturation, halo). Treat low-amplitude variability as unconfirmed.

Position correlates with wavelength: the measured motion can be biased by a shifting centre of light (e.g. an unresolved companion, a variable component, or nebulosity). This is a diagnostic, not a claim about the system.
Some fluxes come from a Gaussian fit to unflagged PSF wings because the core was flagged (e.g. saturated); they are compared only with each other.
Positions are measured with a circular-Gaussian approximation to the PSF on native pixels; the PSF extension is not yet used (ePSF fitting is a planned upgrade).
Fluxes are aperture fluxes without aperture correction; compare only within a wavelength bin.
A significant motion or variability statistic identifies a candidate for follow-up, not a discovery.
